name: Loop of 2 hours from Hörby, gravel preferred, north (shuffled)
description: From a real test (2026-09-25): with gravel preferred, heading north, one loop rode 18 km of a straight 100 km/h road towards Kristianstad, where the plain has no gravel through-route. Riders avoid such roads (in Sweden mostly split 2+1 roads); when gravel can't be had, a loop should still ride curvy, smaller paved roads.
